book.name: MATEO
book.title: QꞌU BꞌAꞌNLA CHAJ CHUSBꞌALTETZ U JESUUS ITZꞌIBꞌA U TIO Unqꞌa bꞌaꞌnla yol uvaꞌ tzꞌibꞌamal kan taꞌn u Mateo tiꞌ u Jesús

content: Nijalpu veꞌt ikaꞌy u Jesús
Vaajil qꞌii stuul, as teqꞌo veꞌt u Jesús u Luꞌeꞌ stiꞌ, tukꞌ u Jacob, as tukꞌ u titzꞌineꞌ uvaꞌ Xhun. As bꞌen veꞌt Aak viꞌ umaꞌl u vitz uvaꞌ nim chit at jeꞌ.
As jalpu veꞌt ikaꞌy Aak vatz chajnaj. Vaꞌlik chit ilitzꞌloꞌlan veꞌt ivatz Aak echeꞌ nibꞌan u qꞌiieꞌ. As vaꞌlik chit ipolal veꞌt u toksaꞌm Aakeꞌ echeꞌ u sajeꞌ.
As chee veꞌt u Moisés tukꞌ u Elías vatz u Jesús tukꞌ chajnaj. As yolon veꞌt tukꞌ Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt u Luꞌ ileꞌ te u Jesús: —Kubꞌaal, bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ la atin veꞌt oꞌ tzitzaꞌ. Asoj la asaꞌ, la kubꞌan oxvoꞌj tal pach: Umaꞌl eetz; umaꞌt tetz u Moisés; as umaꞌt tetz u Elías,— tiꞌk u Luꞌeꞌ.

As antelik kuxh iyolon u Luꞌeꞌ tul chee veꞌt umaꞌl u suutzꞌ uvaꞌ vaꞌlik chit ipolal. As atin veꞌt tiibꞌa u Jesús tukꞌ chajnaj. As tabꞌi veꞌt chajnaj umaꞌl u tuul viꞌ tu u suutzꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ ech ni tal ileꞌ: —¡Aꞌ vunKꞌaoleꞌ u vaaꞌ! ¡As xoꞌn chit sve! ¡As vaꞌl ichiibꞌ veꞌt vaama stiꞌ! ¡As aꞌeꞌ la enima!— tiꞌk u tuul viꞌ tu u suutzꞌeꞌ.
Tul uvaꞌ tabꞌi veꞌt unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ u Jesús u yoleꞌ, as yak kuxh xoꞌv veꞌt chajnaj. As kuꞌ veꞌt chajnaj qaaloj. As taqꞌ veꞌt kuꞌ chajnaj ivatz tu txꞌavaꞌ.
As jetzꞌen veꞌt ok u Jesús kꞌatz chajnaj. Ikan veꞌt ok Aak chajnaj. As ech tal Aak ileꞌ: —Txakpojtaj ex. Yeꞌ kuxh xoꞌv ex,— tiꞌk Aak.
As tul sajin veꞌt chajnaj, as yeꞌxhebꞌil atik veꞌt kꞌatz Aak. Pet Aak kuxh veꞌt atik sijunal.

As tul kuꞌ chꞌuꞌl u Jesús viꞌ u vitzeꞌ tukꞌ chajnaj, as ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ te chajnaj: —Yeꞌxh katil la etalkat kam uvaꞌ kat kꞌuchpu sete. Pet tul la kam VIKꞌAOL U NAJEꞌ as la ul taama unpajte, as aꞌn la etal veꞌteꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As ech tal veꞌt unqꞌa ichusulibꞌ Aak ileꞌ: —¿Kam qꞌi uveꞌ ni tal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ chusel tibꞌ tiꞌ unqꞌa tzaqꞌiteꞌ tan uvaꞌ bꞌaxel la ul u Elías?— tiꞌk chajnaj.
Ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —An chiteꞌ uveꞌ ni tal chajnaj, tan tzꞌibꞌamal kan uvaꞌ bꞌaxel la ul u Elías tiꞌ tul ibꞌanat tuch unqꞌa tenameꞌ tiꞌ u vulebꞌaleꞌ.

Pet tuk val sete, tan ulyeꞌ u Elías. As yeꞌ kat exhlal u tijleꞌmeꞌ. As kat ibꞌan unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ ste kam uvaꞌ kat tal taama unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ stiꞌ. Echat chit tuk ulbꞌeloj VIKꞌAOL U NAJEꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
As pal veꞌt chajnaj tu viyol u Jesús uvaꞌ aꞌ u Xhuneꞌ nikat tal Aak, uvaꞌ nikat aqꞌon kuꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ xeꞌ u aꞌeꞌ.
Nibꞌaꞌnxisa u Jesús umaꞌl u xaak uvaꞌ atik ok subꞌul skꞌatz
As tul oon veꞌt chajnaj kꞌatz unqꞌa mamaꞌla tenameꞌ, as jetzꞌen veꞌt ok umaꞌl u naj kꞌatz u Jesús. Kuꞌ naj qaaloj vatz Aak. As ech tal naj ileꞌ te Aak:
—Pap, txum ivatz umaꞌl vas unkꞌaol, tan atoꞌk umaꞌl u chꞌoꞌm skꞌatz. As kam kuxh nibꞌan taꞌn u chꞌoꞌmeꞌ. As jatpajux kuxh bꞌen naj tu xamal as tukꞌ tu aꞌ.
As kat veqꞌo tzan vatz unqꞌa achusulibꞌeꞌ. As yeꞌ kat olebꞌ chajnaj tiꞌ ibꞌaꞌnxisaleꞌ,— tiꞌk u najeꞌ.

As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —¡Ex chit bꞌa yeꞌ nekꞌujbꞌaꞌ ekꞌuꞌl sviꞌ! ¡As vaꞌlen kuxh vetxumbꞌaleꞌ! ¿Ma tuk kuxh atinoj in sexoꞌl uveꞌ netitzꞌa? ¿As la kuxh kol txꞌebꞌon veꞌt in qꞌa setiꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ekꞌujbꞌaꞌ ekꞌuꞌl sviꞌ? As eteqꞌotaj tzan u xaakeꞌ,— tiꞌk Aak.
As iyaa veꞌt u Jesús u subꞌuleꞌ uveꞌ atik ok kꞌatz u xaakeꞌ. As el veꞌt u subꞌuleꞌ tiꞌ naj. As yak kuxh bꞌaꞌnx veꞌt naj.
As tul uvaꞌ aꞌik kuxh veꞌt u Jesús tukꞌ unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ, as ech tal veꞌt chajnaj ileꞌ te Aak: —¿Kam qꞌi uveꞌ yeꞌ kat olebꞌ oꞌ tiꞌ tel u subꞌuleꞌ kꞌatz u xaakeꞌ?— tiꞌk chajnaj.

Ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —Yeꞌ kat olebꞌ ex tiꞌ tel u subꞌuleꞌ, tan tiꞌ uvaꞌ unbꞌiil kuxh u kꞌujlebꞌal ekꞌuꞌl ati. As tuk val sete, tan ech koj u kꞌujlebꞌal ekꞌuꞌleꞌ echeꞌ umaj iia uvaꞌ tetz mostaza uvaꞌ tzꞌup chittuꞌ, as la etaleꞌ te u vitzeꞌ uvaꞌ: «Qꞌaxen tu umaꞌt u atinbꞌaleꞌ,» chaj ex. As la chit ibꞌaneꞌ kam uvaꞌ la etaleꞌ, tan yeꞌle uvaꞌ yeꞌ koj la uch ebꞌanataꞌ.
Unqꞌa subꞌuleꞌ uvaꞌ echeꞌ u veeꞌ, tan tukꞌ kuxh nacho Tiixh as tukꞌ ikuypu vaꞌy vatz u Tiixheꞌ la elkat,— tiꞌk u Jesús.
Nikaꞌpu u Jesús talat vikamebꞌal
As tul yeꞌxnik el chꞌuꞌl u Jesús tu u Galilea tukꞌ unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ, as ech tal Aak ileꞌ: —Ineꞌ uvaꞌ in VIKꞌAOL U NAJEꞌ, as la oksal ok in tiqꞌabꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ.
As la yatzꞌpu veꞌt in. As la ul vaama titoxvu qꞌii,— tiꞌk Aak. As txumun veꞌt chajnaj taꞌn viyol Aakeꞌ.
Nichoon u Jesús tiꞌ u puajeꞌ uvaꞌ nijajpeꞌ tetz u tostiixheꞌ

As tul oon veꞌt u Jesús tu u Capernaúm tukꞌ unqꞌa ichusulibꞌeꞌ, as jetzꞌen veꞌt ok kaꞌl unqꞌa molol tetz puaj kꞌatz u Luꞌeꞌ, tan nik imolpu puaj tiꞌ ibꞌanchu tuch u tostiixheꞌ. Ech tal chajnaj ileꞌ te u Luꞌeꞌ: —¿Ma ni taqꞌ vechusuleꞌ ikutx?— tiꞌk chajnaj.

—Kano, ni taqꞌ Aakeꞌ,— tiꞌk u Luꞌeꞌ. As tul ok veꞌt u Luꞌeꞌ tu kabꞌal uvaꞌ atikkat u Jesús, as bꞌaxel kat yolon veꞌt Aak vatz u Luꞌeꞌ. Ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: —¿Kam ni tal axh, Simón? ¿Abꞌil nijajpu u puajeꞌ ste taꞌn unqꞌa ijlenaaleꞌ? ¿Ma te unqꞌa aatenameꞌ? ¿Pet moj te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ echen tu umaꞌt u tenam?— tiꞌk u Jesús.

—Aꞌ nijajpukat u puajeꞌ te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ echen tu umaꞌt u tenam,— tiꞌk u Luꞌeꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt u Jesús ileꞌ: —An chiteꞌ uveꞌ naaleꞌ, tan yeꞌxhkam nijajax te unqꞌa aatenameꞌ. As la uchi uvaꞌ yeꞌl kukutx la qaqꞌeꞌ.

Pet tiꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la yan itxumbꞌal unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ sqiꞌ, as kuxh tziꞌ u mar. Aqꞌ bꞌen u txeybꞌal txayeꞌ xeꞌ u aꞌeꞌ. As abꞌiste u txayeꞌ la jeꞌ chꞌuꞌl bꞌaxa as lajaj vitziꞌ txooeꞌ. As la alej umaꞌl u puaj titziꞌ txoo. As la ul achoo u eetzeꞌ tukꞌ u vetzeꞌ, jankꞌal uvaꞌ nijaj chajnaj te unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ,— tiꞌk u Jesús.

footnotes.text: 17.21 At kaꞌt unqꞌa oꞌtla uꞌujeꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ nichee u versículo 21 stuul.
